cat > /tmp/add_ifaces.py <<'PY'
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET, shutil
path = '/conf/config.xml'
shutil.copy(path, path + '.bak_ifaces')
tree = ET.parse(path)
root = tree.getroot()
ifaces = root.find('interfaces')

opt1 = ET.SubElement(ifaces, 'opt1')
ET.SubElement(opt1, 'enable').text = '1'
ET.SubElement(opt1, 'if').text = 'vtnet1'
ET.SubElement(opt1, 'descr').text = 'LAN_A'
ET.SubElement(opt1, 'ipaddr').text = '10.60.1.1'
ET.SubElement(opt1, 'subnet').text = '24'
ET.SubElement(opt1, 'spoofmac').text = ''

opt2 = ET.SubElement(ifaces, 'opt2')
ET.SubElement(opt2, 'enable').text = '1'
ET.SubElement(opt2, 'if').text = 'vtnet2'
ET.SubElement(opt2, 'descr').text = 'LAN_B'
ET.SubElement(opt2, 'ipaddr').text = '10.60.2.1'
ET.SubElement(opt2, 'subnet').text = '24'
ET.SubElement(opt2, 'spoofmac').text = ''

tree.write(path, xml_declaration=True, encoding='utf-8')
print('interfaces added')
PY

if aliases is None:
    opn = root.find('OPNsense')
    if opn is None:
        opn = ET.SubElement(root, 'OPNsense')
    fw = opn.find('Firewall')
    if fw is None:
        fw = ET.SubElement(opn, 'Firewall')
    al = fw.find('Alias')
    if al is None:
        al = ET.SubElement(fw, 'Alias')
    aliases = al.find('aliases')
    if aliases is None:
        aliases = ET.SubElement(al, 'aliases')

import uuid
alias = ET.SubElement(aliases, 'alias', {'uuid': str(uuid.uuid4())})
ET.SubElement(alias, 'enabled').text = '1'
ET.SubElement(alias, 'name').text = 'node3_svc_ports'
ET.SubElement(alias, 'type').text = 'port'
ET.SubElement(alias, 'proto').text = ''
ET.SubElement(alias, 'categories').text = ''
ET.SubElement(alias, 'updatefreq').text = ''
